dialogues.speaker: Hinaeia Nui
dialogues.text: Hmm... Let me think... There's so much fresh food here...

dialogues.speaker: Hinaeia Nui
dialogues.text: Well hey, I'm just the right person to ask for that. I'm the "Gourmet Hunter," and though I haven't reached Nasha Town yet, I've got lots of "gourmet intel" in my pocket already.

dialogues.speaker: Hinaeia Nui
dialogues.text: Heehee, I also often provide inspiration for my restaurant's new dishes, and... Ah, I've gone off on a bit of a tangent. I hear that if you want to try Nod-Krai's local delicacies, Speranza is the place to be!

dialogues.speaker: Hinaeia Nui
dialogues.text: It's said to be a super popular restaurant around these parts, haha. I hope that when the time comes and I have to queue... It'll be a shorter line than this one.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What goods did you bring with you?

dialogues.speaker: Hinaeia Nui
dialogues.text: Heehee, just some specialties from the People of the Springs!

dialogues.speaker: Hinaeia Nui
dialogues.text: That said... Maybe it's because of the difference in temperature, but most of our products aren't very suited to local use...

dialogues.speaker: Hinaeia Nui
dialogues.text: Thank goodness our instruments are still popular! We do have to keep an eye on changes in the wood due to temperature shifts during transport, but it's only a minor inconvenience.

dialogues.speaker: Hinaeia Nui
dialogues.text: Seems like people love music no matter where they are! Isn't that nice?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Stay safe out there. I'll take my leave.
